description:
Create a precise 8-point compass rose symbol in LibreCAD centered at the origin (0,0). 

Specifications:
1. Create a new layer named 'COMPASS_ROSE' and place ALL entities on it.
2. Draw an outer circle centered at (0,0) with radius 100.
3. Draw an inner circle centered at (0,0) with radius 20.
4. Draw 4 cardinal direction lines starting from (0,0) and extending 100 units outward (North to 0,100; East to 100,0; South to 0,-100; West to -100,0).
5. Draw 4 ordinal direction lines (NE, NW, SE, SW) starting from (0,0) and extending 70 units outward at 45-degree angles.
6. Add a text label 'N' above the North point (approx position 0, 110).

Save the drawing as a DXF file to '/home/ga/Documents/LibreCAD/compass_rose.dxf'.
